name: Digital Climate Strike Popup
description: Attaches the Digital Climate Strike participation widget (bottom banner or full-page popup) to the front page.
project_description: Digital Climate Strike Popup adds the third-party Digital Climate Strike participation widget to a Drupal site. An administrator picks one of three widget modes (None, Bottom banner, Page popup) at Configuration > System > Digital Climate Strike Popup Settings. The module ships a single simple config form (SettingsForm) writing the dcs_popup.settings config object, a libraries.yml entry that loads the remote widget script from assets.digitalclimatestrike.net, and a hook_preprocess_page() implementation intended to attach the library on the default theme's front page. More info: https://digital.globalclimatestrike.net
